events.body:
## Context

Several `requests` calls have no timeout: `scripts/fetch_repo_status.py` (7 per repo), `fetch_issues.py`, `main.py`, `scrape_github_links.py` and `sweep.py`. Other calls in the same files do. The daily job can hang on one stalled request.

## What to do

1. Add a module-level `TIMEOUT = 30` and pass it everywhere.
2. Catch `requests.RequestException` where the loop should continue.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every `requests.get/post/head(` line has a timeout
- [ ] `py_compile` passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-owasp-projects
```
